svg.title: Tokens per hour
svg.desc: Bar charts of tokens per hour across the week. All tokens peak at about 337 million in the hour from 22:00 on 18 October; output tokens peak at about 260 thousand an hour.
svg.text: Every API call of every agent, by the hour it was made (UTC-4). Cache reads are most of the top panel.
All tokens (input, output, cache read and cache write)
Output tokens only (what the models wrote)
